title: The Great Commission
definition: The Great Commission is Christ's command for His followers to make disciples of all nations.
summary: The mission of the Church includes going, baptizing, teaching, and making disciples under Christ's authority.
christFocus: The mission of the Church is rooted in Christ's authority and centered on proclaiming His Gospel.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The mission of the Church includes going, baptizing, teaching, and making disciples under Christ's authority.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
